card.name: Digits inside numbers and dates
card.fires_on: A single digit partway through a multi-digit number, such as a year, a clock time, a file size or a page range. It is most often the 1, 5, 9 or 2 that begins or continues the number.

modes.label: Years
modes.description: A digit inside a four-digit year, usually after 19 or 20.

modes.label: Clock times and dates
modes.description: A digit in an hour or timestamp.

modes.label: Other numbers
modes.description: A digit in a size, age or journal number.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, mostly in years and times.
